title: Measuring Fairness with Biased Rulers: A Survey on Quantifying Biases in Pretrained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Correlation analysis of various intrinsic and extrinsic fairness metrics (e.g., SEAT, LPBS, BiasInBios, WinoBias) using binary gendered target words and profession attribute words across different template contexts and embedding extraction methods.

Surveying and analyzing existing fairness metrics and datasets (e.g., SEAT tests comparing European-American vs. African-American names, and crowdsourced stereotype datasets like StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs).
Surveying contextualized language model metrics based on datasets like StereoSet that calculate the frequency of model preference for stereotypes over anti-stereotypes.
Reviewing adaptations of embedding association tests (e.g., SEAT) that measure intersectional stereotypes, such as the "angry Black woman" stereotype.
